description: This file contains functions for retrieving various code snippets for an IDE, including snippets from recent files, clipboard, static context, and LSP definitions, with support for asynchronous operations and race conditions.

methods.name: racePromise
methods.description: Wraps a promise with a timeout, resolving to an empty array if timeout occurs.

methods.name: getIdeSnippets
methods.description: Fetches IDE snippets using LSP, optionally filtering to workspace files.

methods.name: getSnippetsFromRecentlyEditedRanges
methods.description: Returns snippets from recently edited ranges if enabled.

methods.name: getSnippetsFromRecentlyOpenedFiles
methods.description: Reads recently opened files to generate code snippets, with timeout handling.

methods.name: getAllSnippets
methods.description: Aggregates various snippets sources asynchronously with race conditions.

methods.name: getAllSnippetsWithoutRace
methods.description: Aggregates snippets sources without race conditions, for immediate retrieval.
